description: This file defines the 'RecipeListAdapter' class, an implementation of Android's ListAdapter, responsible for managing and displaying a list of recipes in a wearable app. It handles JSON parsing of recipe data, loading associated images, and populating list item views with titles, summaries, and images.

classes.name: RecipeListAdapter
classes.description: A custom list adapter for displaying recipes, managing JSON parsing, view creation, and data observation

methods.name: loadRecipeList
methods.description: Loads and parses the recipe JSON data from assets, then appends items to the list

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses the JSONObject into a list of Item objects, extracting name, title, summary, and image

methods.name: appendItemsToList
methods.description: Adds parsed items to the internal list and notifies data set observers

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the item at a specified position

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns an ID for the item, here always zero

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for an item, here always zero

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a list item view, binding the recipe data (title, summary, image) to UI components

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns total number of view types, here one

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable, here false

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if all items are enabled

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if a specific item is enabled

methods.name: getItemName
methods.description: Provides the name of the recipe at the given position
